sampling: Official GQA Balanced validation only. Exclude all historical manifest/config image IDs and SHA256; input-hash ranking within task, up to500 questions per task without replacement. Repeated images within/across current tasks allowed and clustered; no model-output selection. No fallback to exposed images. Separate smoke images.
intervention: Simultaneous self_attn.o_proj output zeros in frozen layer sets. Four explicit temporal scopes. MLP/LayerNorm/residual native. Every condition independently prefills and generates using its own cache/prefix. No cached Full state reused, no teacher forcing, no actual compute omission or acceleration claim.
phase: Use explicit cache_position, original prompt length, per-layer past length and current query length, not qlen alone.
scoring: Pinned official GQA primary exact answer accuracy after decoded text.strip() and LLaVA rstrip period/lower conversion.

statistics.unit: Paired image-cluster bootstrap, question-weighted sum/count ratio
statistics.correction: Two-sided Bonferroni percentile intervals separately for8 pooled primary S1–S8, 2 pooled auxiliary S9/S10,60 taskwise endpoints (10x6, including unavailable tasks in planned family), and6 pooled prespecified direct contrasts. Ordinary95% also shown. No cross-family simultaneous claim.
statistics.criterion: Corrected lower bound strictly greater than -1pp pooled. Subtask -3pp is a heterogeneity risk screen, not safety.
statistics.caveat: Finite Monte Carlo percentile approximation, not exact simultaneous finite-sample coverage. Zero discordances give degenerate bootstrap; do not interpret as zero population risk. Achieved unequal task counts yield question-weighted observed mixture, not target balanced3000 conclusion.

supplementary: Not run in this core delivery; optional cross-task risk check remains explicitly unexecuted.
boundaries: Only11 conditions on actually frozen eligible GQA questions. No training, layer search, source pruning, Decode time scan or caption task.
